ai.title: German command not found detection
ai.summary: Added German error string 'ist entweder falsch geschrieben oder konnte nicht gefunden werden' to command failure detection in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts. Fixes false negatives when shell outputs localized errors. Scope limited to terminal command handler.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to run a command in your terminal, it now recognizes the German version of the 'command not found' error message. If your system language is set to German and you type a command that doesn't exist, the assistant will correctly report that the command could not be found instead of treating it as something else. This only affects the terminal command feature, and the fix is live today.

ai.title: Version bump to 1.0.126
ai.summary: Version bumped from 1.0.125 to 1.0.126. Update scoped to npm-app/package.json metadata.

eli5.text: You're getting a new release of the assistant that bundles several small improvements shipped over the past week. The most useful change for most people is that documentation pages now show Previous and Next buttons at the bottom, so you can flip through guides without hunting back to the menu. The release also fixes how the docs look on phones, lets you keep using the tool after running out of free credits as an anonymous visitor (now capped at 250), and adds German-language detection for the 'command not found' error. Behind the scenes it also includes a refreshed version of the AI model used for retrying failed edits in lightweight cost-saving mode.

ai.title: Add German command not found detection
ai.summary: Added 'Der Befehl' string check to error detection logic in npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts. This enables proper identification of German-language 'command not found' errors during terminal command execution. Scope limited to internal error handling utilities.

eli5.text: The assistant can now recognize when a terminal command fails because it doesn't exist in German. If the terminal displays an error starting with 'Der Befehl', the system understands this means the command was not found, allowing it to handle German-language error messages accurately. This affects error detection during command execution, improving reliability for German users. This change is live today as part of an update.

ai.title: Version bump to 1.0.127
ai.summary: Incremented package version from 1.0.126 to 1.0.127 in npm-app/package.json. This release cycle update ensures consistent versioning for the codebuff package.

eli5.text: The AI assistant can now understand a common error message written in German, so if you type a command it doesn't recognize, it will respond correctly instead of being confused. This improvement is included in the latest version of the assistant software, which also contains several other small updates and fixes. The change is live today as part of the current release.

ai.title: Self-serve plan changes with Stripe preview and overage tier split
ai.summary: Replaced the single checkout-session flow with a self-serve plan change experience: `/api/stripe/subscription` returns the current plan, `/api/stripe/subscription/change` previews prorations via `stripeServer.invoices.retrieveUpcoming` and applies upgrades/downgrades with `stripeServer.subscriptions.update`. Plans were renamed from `PAID`/`PRO_PLUS` to `PRO`/`MOAR_PRO` in `common/src/constants.ts` (`PLAN_CONFIGS`), with overage rates split into `OVERAGE_RATE_PRO` (0.99) and `OVERAGE_RATE_MOAR_PRO` (0.9) and `OVERAGE_RATE_PRO_PLUS` removed. New Stripe env vars `STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID`/`STRIPE_PRO_OVERAGE_PRICE_ID`/`STRIPE_MOAR_PRO_PRICE_ID`/`STRIPE_MOAR_PRO_OVERAGE_PRICE_ID` replace the single `STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_ID`, and the pricing cards now route to `/subscription/confirm?plan=...`. Retry logic was extracted from `backend/src/claude.ts` into `withRetry` in `common/src/util/promise.ts`, and helper types `InvoiceLineItem`/`SubscriptionPreviewResponse` were added in `common/src/types/plan.ts`.
ai.evidence: web/src/app/api/stripe/subscription/change/route.ts (new file implementing GET preview + POST change with `stripeServer.subscriptions.update`, `stripeServer.invoices.retrieveUpcoming`, and `stripeServer.billing.meterEvents.create`), web/src/app/subscription/confirm/page.tsx (new confirm UI consuming the preview), web/src/app/api/stripe/subscription/route.ts (new GET returning `currentPlan`), web/src/lib/stripe-utils.ts (new helpers `getPlanPriceIds`, `getPlanFromPriceId`, `getSubscriptionItemByType`, `validatePlanChange`, `checkForUnpaidInvoices`, `getTotalReferralCreditsForCustomer`), web/src/components/pricing/paid-plan-footer.tsx + web/src/components/pricing/free-plan-button.tsx (pricing cards now route to /subscription/confirm?plan=...), common/src/constants.ts (plan enum renamed PAID/PRO_PLUS to PRO/MOAR_PRO via PLAN_CONFIGS, OVERAGE_RATE_PRO_PLUS replaced by OVERAGE_RATE_MOAR_PRO, STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_ID removed from backend/src/env.mjs and web/src/env.mjs replaced by STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID/STRIPE_PRO_OVERAGE_PRICE_ID/STRIPE_MOAR_PRO_PRICE_ID/STRIPE_MOAR_PRO_OVERAGE_PRICE_ID), scripts/migrate-stripe-customers.ts deleted, web/src/app/api/stripe/checkout-session/route.ts deleted, web/src/lib/stripe.ts deleted, common/src/util/promise.ts + backend/src/claude.ts (withRetry extracted and promptClaudeStream delegates to it), common/src/types/plan.ts (new InvoiceLineItem/SubscriptionPreviewResponse), common/src/util/string.ts (capitalize added), web/src/components/ui/* (new.
ai.migration: Operators must set STRIPE_PRO_PRICE_ID, STRIPE_PRO_OVERAGE_PRICE_ID, STRIPE_MOAR_PRO_PRICE_ID, and STRIPE_MOAR_PRO_OVERAGE_PRICE_ID in place of the removed STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_ID and STRIPE_OVERAGE_PRICE_ID.

changes.what: Added GET and POST endpoints for reading the current plan and for previewing/applying plan changes via Stripe prorations and meter events.
Renamed plan enum PAID/PRO_PLUS to PRO/MOAR_PRO with a PLAN_CONFIGS table and per-plan overage rates, replacing OVERAGE_RATE_PRO_PLUS with OVERAGE_RATE_MOAR_PRO.
Pricing cards now route to the new self-serve confirm page and render FreePlanButton/PaidPlanFooter based on plan config.
Extracted retry logic into a reusable withRetry helper using INITIAL_RETRY_DELAY and exponential backoff.
promptClaudeStream now delegates retries to withRetry instead of its own inline loop.
Replaced STRIPE_SUBSCRIPTION_PRICE_ID with per-plan pro and moar_pro price and overage env vars across backend and web.

ai.title: AWS keys in .env.example and Claude retry logic refactor
ai.summary: Added AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY to .env.example. Refactored promptClaudeStream in backend/src/claude.ts to use manual loop with exponential backoff for APIConnectionError instead of withRetry. Removed obsolete sections from backend/knowledge.md.

eli5.text: You will now see two new placeholder lines for Amazon login credentials in the example environment file that developers copy, so anyone setting up the assistant on their own computer or server knows they need to provide Amazon access keys alongside the existing Stripe and DeepSeek keys. The assistant's connection to its brain-like service now waits longer between retry attempts when that connection fails temporarily, using a steadily increasing pause instead of the old fixed pattern, which should reduce dropped conversations during brief network hiccups. A separate documentation file had some outdated troubleshooting notes removed, and all of these adjustments are live today.

ai.title: Fix code search pipe handling and add result count
ai.summary: handleCodeSearch now strips double quotes from input.pattern before wrapping it in shell-safe double quotes for ripgrep. This fixes failures when the pattern contains pipe characters or existing quotes. The tool handler also prints the number of results found using stdout line count. Changes are limited to npm-app/src/tool-handlers.ts.

eli5.text: When you search across your project's files, the search now works correctly even if your search terms include special characters like the pipe symbol (|) or quote marks ("). Previously, typing something like "data | processing" into the search box would cause the search to fail silently or return confusing errors. Now, the system cleans up your search terms before running them, so you'll get reliable results regardless of what you type in. You'll also see a count of how many matches were found, like "23 results", so you know immediately whether your search cast a wide net or came up empty.

ai.summary: Package version incremented to 1.0.128. Internal release process update. Scope limited to npm-app/package.json.

eli5.text: People who pay for the Pro and Moar Pro plans can now change their own subscription level through the assistant's billing page, without needing to contact support. Previously, adjusting between these plans required manual help from the team; now the upgrade or downgrade happens automatically when you pick a new plan. This is live today for anyone on those two paid tiers.
